note: Windmill prefabs for the revolving playground (Palle, 2026-11-09). Read by grid_playground.gd when the placement config has "windmills": true; builder commons/modular/windmill.gd. Each windmill grows from an existing top joint of a dock tower (its corner) and turns beside the walkway, never through the structure (tools/probes/playground_white_windmills.gd). The free-floating rotors they replace are dropped in memory only; revolving.json is untouched.

windmills.note: dock-1's outer corner where bay-0 arrives; the stand runs along the dock's outer edge, the axle over the bridge end: face the sails
dock-3's outer corner where bay-2 arrives; two sails across the outer side of the walkway
dock-3's outer corner where bay-3 leaves; a 1 m mast and a 1 m bar, two upright paddles at hip height

bay-0.title: 02 / Windmill X / face the sails
bay-0.hint: Three sails turn across the bridge end. Keep to the open inner side, or pass while they are up.

bay-2.title: 04 / Windmill Z / the open side
bay-2.hint: Two sails turn over the outer half of the bridge end. Keep to the inner side, or time them.

bay-3.title: 05 / Windmill Y / time the paddles
bay-3.hint: Two paddles revolve on the corner at hip height. Let one pass, then go.
